# MUSE Unisex Salon

> MUSE is a unisex hair and beauty salon in Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India, offering haircuts, hair spa, keratin and other hair treatments, colouring, facials, grooming, and bridal and groom packages.

- Address: D-93, Pamurkh Mastana Complex, Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 63552 55733
- Email: parekhdarshan19@gmail.com
- Hours: Daily, 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- Lead stylist: Darshan Nai (Master Hair Stylist). The salon's own site says he trained at salons in Mehsana and Ahmedabad.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/muse_unisex_salon

## Pages

- [Home and full service list](https://www.muse-salons.com/): Single-page site with services, bridal and groom packages, team, gallery and contact details.

## Services

- Men: haircut, hairstyling, shaving, beard trim and shape, hair spa, head massage, facial, hair colouring, straightening, keratin, botox / nanoplastia, hydrating hair treatment, hair highlighting, eyebrow grooming.
- Women: haircut, hair wash, blow dry, deep conditioning, hair spa, keratin, straightening, botox, curls, straight look, beach waves, balayage, babylights, global colour, root touch-up, highlights, hair extensions (all types), pedicure, manicure, waxing.

## Wedding packages

- Bridal: The Classic Bride, The Radiant Bride, The Muse Royal Bride (includes a makeup trial).
- Groom: The Classic Groom, The Dapper Groom, The Muse Royal Groom.
- Package contents are listed on the home page. Contact the salon for details.
